findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for controller requests
findings.body: This is the only call that loads the configured fallback chain. `translate_accelerator.rb` loads only the active locale when `I18n.t` is called, so translations performed outside an `ApplicationController` request—such as in background jobs or standalone mailer execution—can try the site-default/English fallback without those locale files loaded and incorrectly return a missing translation.

findings.title: Changing the site default locale leaves cached fallback results stale
findings.body: The fallback chain depends on the runtime `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation cache is keyed only by translation key, active locale, and backend. If the site default locale changes, cached translations for keys missing in the active locale continue returning the old fallback translation until the cache is evicted or cleared, even though lookups should now use the new default.
